summary: If a2 and the object pointer it holds at +24 are non-null, calls a virtual __stdcall method at vtable offset +48 on that object, stores the returned value into *this, and if the returned value is zero decrements the counter at a2+12.

local_names.v4: virtual call return value stored into *this

operations.description: Check that a2 is non-null before dereferencing it.
Check that the object pointer read from a2+24 is non-null before invoking its vtable.
Invoke the virtual __stdcall method at vtable offset +48 on the object pointer read from a2+24.
Store the virtual call return value into the dword pointed to by this (this+0).
If the stored return value is zero, decrement the counter dword at a2+12.

unresolved: Identity and behavior of the virtual method at vtable offset +48 on the a2+24 object is unknown.
Semantics of the counter at a2+12 and of the return value stored into *this (reference/lock count) are unproven.
